messages:
elaine-marketing: Heads-up — we're aiming to publish the new Latency & Cost benchmark blog at 11:00 PT next Tuesday (May 12). Draft is in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/bench-draft

sam-pr: :thumbsup: PR will hold embargo until publish. Any outlets that need an exception? Need a list by EOD Mon.

mike-product: Numbers check — infra validated. 95th-pct latency down ~28% vs our baseline, cost per 1M tokens ~34% reduction. Raw data + bench scripts in repo: github.com/redwood/bench/2026-05

anya-legal: Please add the model + infra appendix (versions, quantization, flags). Also include standard embargo language. I'll do a pass tonight.

jenna-growth: Marketing plan: blog + 3 social posts + one short explainer gif. Can design deliver final assets by Tue 07:00 PT? @elaine-marketing @sam-pr

elaine-marketing: tagging design now. Need a 1-2 sentence quote from exec for the press release — @leslie-cto or I can draft, but prefer CTO voice. @mike-product can you loop her in?

mike-product: Pinged leslie-cto — she replied with a short quote and I've pasted it into the doc: "This benchmark shows how serving optimizations unlock real-world cost savings while maintaining quality."

ci-bot: deploy: preview site for the benchmark live at https://preview.redwood.ai/bench/176 — build #5482. Please verify visuals/figures.

sam-pr: Recap/timeline: final draft by 20:00 PT Mon, embargo list to PR by EOD Mon, design assets by Tue 07:00 PT, preview verification by Tue 09:00 PT. I'll assemble the press kit once final approved.

elaine-marketing: Sounds good. If legal or infra find anything blocking flag it ASAP. I'll create a launch workspace and calendar invites once everything is green.

anya-legal: No blockers currently. One request: explicitly note that the models used were pinned versions and not fine-tuned on benchmark data — I'll add that sentence to the appendix.

jenna-growth: /me scheduling social drafts and creatives :rocket:
